prayers.title: For this day
prayers.body: Father, keep me near you through this day. Give me the daily bread I need, a willing heart for your will, and patience with each person I meet. Help me choose faithful action, speak truth with kindness, and love my neighbor in the work before me. In Jesus' name. Amen.
prayers.action: Complete one needed task, then help one person without seeking notice.

prayers.title: With gratitude
prayers.body: God, thank you for the good I have received: life, daily bread, people who care for me, and mercy that meets me again. Keep gratitude from ending in words. Teach me to share what I have, notice another person's need, and remain with Christ in generous love. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.action: Write down one remembered deed of the Lord and thank someone involved.

prayers.title: For guidance
prayers.body: Lord, I do not see every consequence of the choice before me. Shape my desires around your will. Give me honesty about my motives, wisdom to seek counsel, and courage to take the next faithful step. Keep me close to Christ, attentive to mercy, and ready to love my neighbor through what I decide. In Jesus' name. Amen.
prayers.action: Ask a trustworthy person for counsel before making the decision.

prayers.title: For my family
prayers.body: Father, hold my family in your mercy. Teach us to listen before answering, forgive without keeping score, and meet ordinary needs with patient love. Where there is strain, help us seek peace truthfully. Give us our daily bread and make our home ready to welcome and serve others. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.action: Do one household task that would ease another person's burden.

prayers.title: In need of healing
prayers.body: God, I bring you my pain and my need for healing. Have mercy on me. Give skill and compassion to those who care for me, patience for each day, and courage to ask for help. Keep me near Christ when I am afraid. Help me receive support and still offer love to the people beside me. In Jesus' name. Amen.
prayers.action: Contact a qualified caregiver or trusted supporter about one needed next step.

prayers.title: Before work
prayers.body: Lord, receive the work before me today. Help me do it honestly, carefully, and for the good of those it affects. Guard me from cutting corners or treating people as tools. Give me daily bread, fair judgment, and readiness to correct mistakes. May my work become faithful service of my neighbor. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.action: Correct one known mistake or finish one responsibility with care.

prayers.title: To ask forgiveness
prayers.body: Father, I need your mercy. Show me where I have harmed another person, and free me from excuses. Help me confess plainly, ask forgiveness without demanding it, and make repair where I can. As you teach me to forgive, keep me from revenge and guide me toward truthful peace. In Jesus' name. Amen.
prayers.action: Offer one specific apology without defending yourself.

prayers.title: In a difficult time
prayers.body: God, this time is hard, and I do not know how it will end. Stay near me in Christ. Give me daily bread for this day, mercy when strength is low, and courage for the next faithful action. Keep me from carrying this alone. Help me receive practical care and remain able to love the neighbor before me. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.action: Tell one trusted person what practical help you need today.

prayers.title: Renew my mind
prayers.body: Father, in Christ I belong to you. By Jesus' blood, forgive and cleanse me when I fall. Let shame yield to your mercy. Renew my mind with your truth. When an old image, craving, fear, or proud thought rises, help me turn toward what is good. Teach me to answer temptation with your Word, guard what I watch, and seek real connection instead of hiding. Holy Spirit, help me test every impression through Scripture, love, wisdom, and its fruit. Grow in me self control, peace, and courage. Heal the habits I cannot change alone, and lead me into one faithful act of love today. In Jesus' name. Amen.
prayers.action: Name one trigger and read a fitting Scripture passage morning, midday, and evening.
